title: miR-493-5p, miR-3662, miR-589-3p, human A549 cells, LC-MSMS
projectDescription: miR-493-5p, miR-3662, and miR-589-3p were estimated as working microRNAs in bleomycin- and methotrexate-induced phenotypic changes in A549 cells via microRNAs-Proteins Analysis of Integrative Relationship (miR-PAIR). To verify the effect of these miRNAs on the their target protein expression levels, comprehensive expression of proteins in A549 cells treated with miR-493-59, miR-3662, and miR-589-3p mimic was examined by SWATH-MS method. As expected by a miR-PAIR mehtod, almost target proteins were succesfully regulated by miR-493-5p and miR-589-3p mimics.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein digestion from the cells was performed using 50 μg of protein per tube. Trypsin digests were washed using Self-Pack SDB-XD 200 μL tips (3M, Maplewood, MN, USA). The cleaned peptide samples (0.5 μg peptide) were injected into a NanoLC 425 system (Eksigent Technologies, Dublin, CA, USA) coupled with a Zeno-TOF 7600 mass spectrometer (SCIEX, Framingham, MA, USA), which was set up for a single direct injection and analyzed by SWATH-MS acquisition.
dataProcessingProtocol: Protein identification and quantification of SWATH data were performed using DIA-NN version 1.8.1, with DIA-NN default settings used, match-between-runs (MBR) enabled, and “Protein names (from FASTA)” was selected for protein estimation. Protein levels were determined as a MAXLFQ value estimated by DIA-NN.
